standard_prerequisites.use: Every etale morphism is locally standard etale (Morphisms), and the algebra lemma that standard etale neighbourhoods of affine schemes are dominated by finite free rings after Zariski localization; cited inputs with the reduction written in the retained span.

core_obligations: Shrink S to an open neighbourhood of s and U to an open neighbourhood of u.
Reduce to a standard etale morphism of affine schemes U -> S.
Apply the algebra lemma giving a finite locally free cover splitting the standard etale neighbourhood.
Assemble the neighbourhoods W_t and maps h_t with h_t(t) = u.

proof_roadmap.step: Reduce to the standard etale affine case by shrinking.
Invoke the finite flat splitting lemma for standard etale neighbourhoods.

difficulty_reason: Given an etale neighbourhood f : (U, u) -> (S, s), the lemma produces an affine open neighbourhood V of s and a surjective finite locally free morphism pi : T -> V such that over each point t in the fibre of pi above s there is an open neighbourhood W_t of t and a map h_t : W_t -> U over S sending t to u, i.e. the etale neighbourhood is dominated locally on a finite flat cover. The retained proof is a written reduction: the question is local on S so shrink to any neighbourhood of s, replace U by an open neighbourhood of u, use the standard-etale presentation lemma to assume U -> S is a standard etale morphism of affines, and conclude with V = S from the algebra lemma exhibiting finite flat covers that split standard etale neighbourhoods. Retained author proof at lines 11840-11849.
